title: Build your resume, one question at a time
purpose: Turn what you've done into a resume where every line is true, specific and yours, then download it.
why: Hiring software checks each required skill against your lines, and a recruiter skims the top in seconds. Specific, checkable lines are what still stand out now that anyone can polish a resume with AI.
evidence: A downloaded resume where you confirmed every line.

tasks.title: Answer the questions and confirm every line
how: Start from the resume you have. The builder reads every line, keeps your words, and asks about what's missing, one question at a time.
Rough numbers are fine; say "about". Skip anything you can't answer.
Only lines you confirm go on your resume.
tasks.done_when: Every line on your resume is confirmed.

tasks.title: Download it as Word and PDF
tasks.done_when: You have the Word file and the PDF saved where you apply from.
